description: Unofficial fan-art Taro Sakamoto companion from Sakamoto Days in his present-day rounded shopkeeper form. Original grocery-bag packing, soft-can steadying, receipt rolling and grounded shuffle animations keep his mustard shirt and green apron silhouette. Props are lightweight shopkeeping models with unreadable labels; no weapons or combat-form transformation. Not affiliated with the original creators.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
